description: A person or a place, at one of a few sizes. It is the anchor other things attach to — a presence dot, an edit affordance — rather than a decoration.

MUST: Render at radius full, and clip its content to that shape.
Take the list leading size inside a list row, so the separator inset stays derivable.
Place an attached affordance on the trailing-bottom corner, which mirrors under right-to-left.
Announce as a person rather than as an image, or be excluded from semantics when a name sits beside it.
SHOULD: Render a declared placeholder when there is no image, rather than initials in a grey circle.
Keep an attached affordance proportional — a badge that rivals the avatar is a button with an avatar behind it.
NEVER: Fake a photograph. This system ships no photography.
Use a square avatar for a person.
